items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: He gave me a dressing down every so often too, because I wasn’t assuming my responsibilities when I played on the band right.

ctx.x: You seem to have had a pretty special relationship with Thad Jones. What a guy.

He was wonderful. I was devastated when he left New York number one, and number two when I heard he was sick. I didn’t know what to do about it. He wasn’t taking any calls or anything. But I found out. Jerome Richardson told me what a special feeling Thad had for me, and I mean he brought me to tears, literally. He gave me a dressing down every so often too, because I wasn’t assuming my responsibilities when I played on the band right. I was still flaking off occasionally and trying, you know partying and having…
